trial_court: Family Court, Civil Proceeding No.287 of 2022
case_name: Soumyarani Mahapatra vs Himanshu Bhusan Rout
facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife was driven out from the house by her husband and is living with her father in Banpur. She has filed a case under Section-9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 and another under Section 125 Cr.P.C.

legal_principles.principle: Directions are usually issued regarding mode of filing of objection and dispensing with personal appearance in proceedings under Section-9 of the Hindu Marriage Act.
legal_principles.held: Instead of transferring the proceedings, directions are usually issued regarding mode of filing of objection and dispensing with personal appearance filing of the wife.

legal_principles.principle: In the interest of justice, proceedings can be transferred to a more convenient court.
legal_principles.held: It would be expedient in the interest of justice to transfer Civil Proceeding No.287 of 2022 pending in the Court of the learned Judge, Family Court, Bhubaneswar, to the Court of learned Judge, Family Court, Khurda (Camp Court), Banpur.

outcome.final_order: Directions are usually issued regarding mode of filing of objection and dispensing with personal appearance filing of the wife. The two cases will be posted on the same day and Civil Proceeding No.287 of 2022 will be disposed of within a specified time limit.
